t: GitHub Pages & Jekyll: Solving Chronological Sorting for Multiple Daily Posts
s: This article details custom solutions for Jekyll on GitHub Pages to correctly sort posts published on the same day using `sort_order`, addressing issues with 'latest post' linking and broken navigation arrows by implementing a refined Liquid templating approach and a custom flat index.
sub: Fixing 'latest post' link logic on index pages
Custom Liquid templating for post ordering
Flat indexing for precise post sequence
